def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    def rot90(a): return [list(row) for row in zip(*a[::-1])]
    r90=rot90(grid)
    r180=rot90(r90)
    r270=rot90(r180)
    return [grid[i]+r90[i] for i in range(h)] + [r270[i]+r180[i] for i in range(h)]
